findings.reason: Off-dictionary `--c-orange` on a declined user-input card was replaced with `--c-red` (danger), so a normal decline now reads like a failure; `--c-yellow-ink`/`--c-subtle` would keep the old meaning. Likewise `--c-yellow-soft` → `--c-panel` in the frontend-mockups warnings boxes drops the warning tint. Visual changes for a human to accept, not correctness bugs.
